description: This file implements a Worker class for managing migration jobs in Mattermost, including job execution, cancellation, and status updates.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: A worker responsible for executing migration jobs, handling job lifecycle including start, stop, cancellation, and status updates.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new Worker instance with provided job server and store.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker's main loop to process jobs and handle stop signals.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Signals the worker to stop processing jobs and waits for it to finish.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel through which jobs are received.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the worker is enabled; always returns true.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Executes a given job, handling claiming, cancellation, execution, and status updates.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks a job as successfully completed.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Marks a job as failed with an error.

methods.name: runMigration
methods.description: Runs a specific migration based on the key, updates system state upon completion.
